subject: Human Evolution
title: Why Cooking Matters
description: A quick win: understand Why Cooking Matters.

hook.text: No human culture on Earth eats entirely raw food. Cooking is universal—and biologically necessary.

buildup.text: Heat denatures proteins and gelatinizes starch, making nutrients far more available to our guts.

discovery.text: Cooked food delivers 30–50% more net calories than the same food raw. It's a massive energy boost.

twist.text: Raw-food dieters in modern studies consistently lose weight—their bodies can't extract enough energy.

climax.text: We're biologically adapted to cooked food. Our small teeth, short guts, and big brains require it.

punchline.text: Humans are the animal that must cook to thrive.

quiz.question: Why is cooking biologically essential for humans?
options: Our bodies are adapted to cooked food's higher calorie yield
